text: {"name":"mm_process_pbd_flags","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Process packet-buffer descriptor flags, conditionally append descriptor/status bytes, and allocate or attach an MM buffer context when the descriptor state indicates completion is needed.","subsystem":"mm","var_renames":{"a1":"pkt_desc","a2":"status_out","a3":"length","a5":"table_index","v5":"desc_flags","v6":"pbd","v16":"desc_u16","v26":"pbd_status_word","v28":"pbd_length","v29":"pbd_required_size","v30":"pbd_data_addr","v14":"desc_head","v22":"new_buf","v23":"buf_ctx","v24":"pbd_ptr","v25":"entry_table_base"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":0,"meaning":"descriptor head word copied to status_out and used to detect empty/first-packet condition"},{"offset":4,"meaning":"u16 descriptor counter or status field"},{"offset":30,"meaning":"u16 descriptor flags field, tested with bit 0x8"},{"offset":36,"meaning":"u32 descriptor flags word, tested with bit 0x200000"},{"offset":68,"meaning":"pointer to already-associated MM buffer context, or 0 when allocation is needed"},{"offset":76,"meaning":"pointer to packet buffer descriptor / pbd array"},{"offset":82,"meaning":"u16 descriptor flags, bit 4 gates completion processing"},{"offset":12,"meaning":"new MM context byte copied from descriptor+29"},{"offset":14,"meaning":"new MM context status/completion byte set to 1"},{"offset":32,"meaning":"new MM context associated pbd pointer written later"},{"offset":40,"meaning":"new MM context length/offset copied from pbd length word"},{"offset":324,"meaning":"back-pointer from MM context to owning packet descriptor"}]}
